title: Fragment: Votary Rite
obscured_text: The text knots into a red lattice. It can be traced, but not understood.
A faint pressure answers your pulse and then falls silent.
revealed_text: The Votary Rite is a second promise: not mastery, but membership. The Hematic Order names the practitioner as one who may carry another portion of the old inheritance.
The mark warns that hunger and devotion share a doorway. Enter carefully.
